calculation.description: Ranks assets for five-day forward returns by the negative of their three-day cumulative return after removing the contemporaneous cross-sectional mean move. Positive values identify assets that underperformed peers over three days and may mean-revert.

validation.regime_notes: Five-day paper IC and ICIR pass the benchmark gates. ICIR is strongest in 2025-2026 (0.1887) and weaker in 2020-2024; 2027-to-date is positive but below the admission ICIR threshold. Small cross-asset universe uncertainty is treated conservatively.
